title: Invalidation of Central Authority acts
description: Acts of the Central Authority are not invalid due to certain reasons

content.general_rule: No act or proceeding of the Central Authority shall be invalid merely by reason of any vacancy, defect in constitution, defect in appointment of Chief Commissioner or Commissioner, or irregularity in procedure not affecting the merits of the case.
content.exception: No act or proceeding of the Central Authority shall be invalid merely by reason of vacancy, defect in constitution, defect in appointment, or irregularity in procedure not affecting the merits of the case
conditions: vacancy in, or defect in the constitution of, the Central Authority
defect in the appointment of a person acting as the Chief Commissioner or as a Commissioner
irregularity in the procedure of the Central Authority not affecting the merits of the case
